_comment: FS25 Pelican/Pterodactyl egg using the unmodified wine-gameservers image directly.
name: Farming Simulator 25 - wine-gameservers upstream
author: DasEric@users.noreply.github.com
description: Uses toetje585/arch-fs25server:latest directly. A BASH_ENV compatibility hook bypasses the image's root-oriented init script so it runs with the non-root, read-only-rootfs container contract used by Pelican/Wings.
startup: Upstream CMD intercepted by BASH_ENV compatibility hook

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.fs25-egg /mnt/server/{game,config,installer,dlc,logs,Desktop}
cat > /mnt/server/.fs25-egg/bash-env.sh <<'FS25_BASH-ENV_SH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# The upstream image starts /bin/bash /usr/bin/init.sh. Stock Pelican/Wings
# cannot run that root-oriented init script, so Bash loads this hook first.
runtime_root="${FS25_COMPAT_ROOT:-/home/container}/.fs25-runtime/wine-11.0-1/root"
if [[ -x "${runtime_root}/usr/bin/wine" ]]; then
    export PATH="${runtime_root}/usr/bin:${PATH}"
    export WINEDLLPATH="${runtime_root}/usr/lib/wine${WINEDLLPATH:+:${WINEDLLPATH}}"
fi

if [[ "${FS25_PELICAN_COMPAT_ACTIVE:-0}" != "1" ]]; then
    export FS25_PELICAN_COMPAT_ACTIVE=1
    exec "${FS25_COMPAT_ROOT:-/home/container}/.fs25-egg/start.sh"
fi
FS25_BASH-ENV_SH
cat > /mnt/server/.fs25-egg/wine-runtime.sh <<'FS25_WINE-RUNTIME_SH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

export HOME="${FS25_HOME:-/home/container}"

FS25_WINE_RUNTIME_MODE="${WINE_RUNTIME_MODE:-portable11}"
FS25_WINE_VERSION="11.0-1"
FS25_WINE_SHA256="C93A939DE66F3DDFA378B3EA2FB01F800477955F4CB623A81E94DA1835B20C56"
FS25_WINE_URL="${WINE_RUNTIME_URL:-https://archive.archlinux.org/packages/w/wine/wine-${FS25_WINE_VERSION}-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst}"
FS25_WINE_BASE="${HOME}/.fs25-runtime"
FS25_WINE_DIR="${FS25_WINE_BASE}/wine-${FS25_WINE_VERSION}"
FS25_WINE_ROOT="${FS25_WINE_DIR}/root"
FS25_WINE_PACKAGE="${FS25_WINE_BASE}/wine-${FS25_WINE_VERSION}.pkg.tar.zst"

fs25_activate_wine_runtime() {
    export PATH="${FS25_WINE_ROOT}/usr/bin:${PATH}"
    export WINEDLLPATH="${FS25_WINE_ROOT}/usr/lib/wine${WINEDLLPATH:+:${WINEDLLPATH}}"
}

if [[ "${FS25_WINE_RUNTIME_MODE}" == "system" ]]; then
    echo "[FS25] Wine-Runtime: Systemversion $(wine --version 2>&1)."
    return 0 2>/dev/null || exit 0
fi

if [[ "${FS25_WINE_RUNTIME_MODE}" != "portable11" ]]; then
    echo "[FS25] Ungültiger WINE_RUNTIME_MODE: ${FS25_WINE_RUNTIME_MODE}"
    return 1 2>/dev/null || exit 1
fi

if [[ ! -x "${FS25_WINE_ROOT}/usr/bin/wine" || ! -f "${FS25_WINE_DIR}/.ready" ]]; then
    mkdir -p "${FS25_WINE_BASE}"
    echo "[FS25] Offizielles Arch-Wine ${FS25_WINE_VERSION} wird einmalig vorbereitet."

    if [[ ! -f "${FS25_WINE_PACKAGE}" ]] || \
       [[ "$(sha256sum "${FS25_WINE_PACKAGE}" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print toupper($1)}')" != "${FS25_WINE_SHA256}" ]]; then
        rm -f "${FS25_WINE_PACKAGE}.part"
        if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            curl --fail --location --retry 4 --retry-delay 3 \
                --output "${FS25_WINE_PACKAGE}.part" "${FS25_WINE_URL}"
        elif command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            wget -O "${FS25_WINE_PACKAGE}.part" "${FS25_WINE_URL}"
        else
            echo "[FS25] Weder curl noch wget ist zum Laden der Wine-Runtime vorhanden."
            return 1 2>/dev/null || exit 1
        fi
        mv "${FS25_WINE_PACKAGE}.part" "${FS25_WINE_PACKAGE}"
    fi

    actual_sha="$(sha256sum "${FS25_WINE_PACKAGE}" | awk '{print toupper($1)}')"
    if [[ "${actual_sha}" != "${FS25_WINE_SHA256}" ]]; then
        echo "[FS25] Wine-Paket-Prüfsumme falsch: ${actual_sha}"
        return 1 2>/dev/null || exit 1
    fi

    extract_dir="${FS25_WINE_DIR}.extracting"
    rm -rf "${extract_dir}"
    mkdir -p "${extract_dir}/root"
    echo "[FS25] Entpacke Wine ${FS25_WINE_VERSION} ..."
    if command -v bsdtar >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        bsdtar -xf "${FS25_WINE_PACKAGE}" -C "${extract_dir}/root"
    elif tar --help 2>&1 | grep -q -- '--zstd'; then
        tar --zstd -xf "${FS25_WINE_PACKAGE}" -C "${extract_dir}/root"
    elif command -v 7zz >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        7zz x -so "${FS25_WINE_PACKAGE}" | 7zz x -si -ttar -o"${extract_dir}/root" -y
    else
        echo "[FS25] Kein Entpacker für das verifizierte Wine-Paket vorhanden."
        return 1 2>/dev/null || exit 1
    fi

    [[ -x "${extract_dir}/root/usr/bin/wine" ]] || {
        echo "[FS25] Wine-Paket wurde unvollständig entpackt."
        return 1 2>/dev/null || exit 1
    }
    printf '%s\n' "${FS25_WINE_SHA256}" >"${extract_dir}/.ready"
    rm -rf "${FS25_WINE_DIR}"
    mv "${extract_dir}" "${FS25_WINE_DIR}"
fi

fs25_activate_wine_runtime
runtime_version="$(wine --version 2>&1)"
if [[ "${runtime_version}" != wine-11.0* ]]; then
    echo "[FS25] Unerwartete portable Wine-Version: ${runtime_version}"
    return 1 2>/dev/null || exit 1
fi
echo "[FS25] Wine-Runtime aktiv: ${runtime_version} (${FS25_WINE_ROOT})."
FS25_WINE-RUNTIME_SH
cat > /mnt/server/.fs25-egg/configure-headless-wine.sh <<'FS25_CONFIGURE-HEADLESS-WINE_SH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

export HOME="${FS25_HOME:-/home/container}"
export WINEPREFIX="${HOME}/.fs25server"
export WINEARCH=win64
export WINEDEBUG="${WINEDEBUG:--all}"

STATE_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${STATE_DIR}/wine-runtime.sh"

if [[ "${WINE_AUDIO_MODE:-disabled}" == "disabled" ]]; then
    export WINEDLLOVERRIDES="${WINEDLLOVERRIDES:-mscoree=d};winealsa.drv=d;winepulse.drv=d;winedbg.exe=d"
    marker="${WINEPREFIX}/.fs25-headless-audio-disabled"
    if [[ ! -f "${marker}" ]]; then
        echo "[FS25] Deaktiviere Wine-Audio und den Crash-Debugger für den Headless-Server."
        timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 60s \
            wine reg add 'HKCU\Software\Wine\Drivers' /v Audio /t REG_SZ /d disabled /f \
            >/dev/null 2>&1
        mkdir -p "${WINEPREFIX}"
        touch "${marker}"
    fi
else
    echo "[FS25] Wine-Audio bleibt aktiviert (${WINE_AUDIO_MODE})."
fi
FS25_CONFIGURE-HEADLESS-WINE_SH
cat > /mnt/server/.fs25-egg/ensure-wine-prefix.sh <<'FS25_ENSURE-WINE-PREFIX_SH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

export HOME="${FS25_HOME:-/home/container}"
export USER=container
export LOGNAME=container
export WINEPREFIX="${HOME}/.fs25server"
export WINEARCH=win64
export WINEDEBUG="${WINEDEBUG:--all}"
export WINEDLLOVERRIDES="${WINEDLLOVERRIDES:-mscoree=d}"

STATE_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${STATE_DIR}/wine-runtime.sh"

WINEBOOT_TIMEOUT="${WINEBOOT_TIMEOUT:-180}"
WINECHECK_TIMEOUT="${WINECHECK_TIMEOUT:-45}"

LOG_DIR="${HOME}/logs"
mkdir -p "${LOG_DIR}"

prefix_files_exist() {
    [[ -s "${WINEPREFIX}/system.reg" ]] &&
    [[ -f "${WINEPREFIX}/drive_c/windows/system32/kernel32.dll" ]] &&
    [[ -f "${WINEPREFIX}/drive_c/windows/system32/cmd.exe" ]]
}

prefix_runs() {
    timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s "${WINECHECK_TIMEOUT}s" \
        wine cmd /d /c "exit 0" 2>&1 | tee "${LOG_DIR}/wine-prefix-check.log"
}

prefix_healthy() {
    prefix_files_exist && prefix_runs
}

if prefix_healthy; then
    echo "[FS25] Wine-Prefix ist vollständig und ausführbar."
    exit 0
fi

for attempt in 1 2; do
    if [[ -e "${WINEPREFIX}" ]]; then
        wineserver -k >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
        broken="${WINEPREFIX}.broken-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)-${attempt}"
        mv "${WINEPREFIX}" "${broken}"
        echo "[FS25] Unvollständiger Wine-Prefix wurde nach ${broken} verschoben."
    fi

    mkdir -p "${WINEPREFIX}"
    echo "[FS25] Wine-Prefix wird neu erzeugt (Versuch ${attempt}/2)."
    echo "[FS25] Wine: $(wine --version 2>&1); Benutzer: $(id -u):$(id -g); Timeout: ${WINEBOOT_TIMEOUT}s"
    if timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15s "${WINEBOOT_TIMEOUT}s" \
        wineboot --init 2>&1 | tee "${LOG_DIR}/wineboot.log"; then
        echo "[FS25] wineboot wurde beendet; Prefix-Dateien werden geprüft."
    else
        status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
        echo "[FS25] wineboot endete mit Status ${status}; der Prefix wird geprüft und bei Bedarf neu erzeugt."
        wineserver -k >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    fi

    if prefix_healthy; then
        echo "[FS25] Wine-Prefix wurde erfolgreich verifiziert."
        exit 0
    fi

    echo "[FS25] Wine-Prefix-Prüfung ${attempt}/2 fehlgeschlagen."
    tail -n 40 "${LOG_DIR}/wineboot.log" 2>/dev/null || true
    tail -n 20 "${LOG_DIR}/wine-prefix-check.log" 2>/dev/null || true
done

echo "[FS25] Wine-Prefix konnte nicht funktionsfähig angelegt werden."
exit 1
FS25_ENSURE-WINE-PREFIX_SH
cat > /mnt/server/.fs25-egg/start-desktop.sh <<'FS25_START-DESKTOP_SH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

export HOME="${FS25_HOME:-/home/container}"
export DISPLAY="${DISPLAY:-:0}"
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/tmp/xdg-runtime-fs25}"

LOG_DIR="${HOME}/logs"
SESSION_LOG="${LOG_DIR}/xfce.log"
mkdir -p "${LOG_DIR}" "${HOME}/Desktop" "${HOME}/.config" "${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR}"
chmod 700 "${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR}"

# A restored XFCE session from the upstream image can contain only the Wine
# console. Always build a clean session so noVNC has a window manager, panel,
# and desktop icons while activation and DLC dialogs are open.
rm -rf "${HOME}/.cache/sessions"
cat >"${HOME}/.config/user-dirs.dirs" <<EOF
XDG_DESKTOP_DIR="${HOME}/Desktop"
EOF

if command -v dbus-launch >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    eval "$(dbus-launch --sh-syntax)"
    export DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS DBUS_SESSION_BUS_PID
fi

: >"${SESSION_LOG}"
if command -v startxfce4 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    startxfce4 >>"${SESSION_LOG}" 2>&1 &
fi

sleep 4

start_missing() {
    local process="$1"
    shift
    if ! pgrep -u "$(id -u)" -x "${process}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        "$@" >>"${SESSION_LOG}" 2>&1 &
    fi
}

# Explicit fallbacks fix the black noVNC root window if startxfce4 exits early
# or restores an incomplete session.
start_missing xfsettingsd xfsettingsd
start_missing xfwm4 xfwm4 --replace --compositor=off
start_missing xfdesktop xfdesktop
start_missing xfce4-panel xfce4-panel

echo "[FS25] XFCE-Desktopkomponenten wurden gestartet." >>"${SESSION_LOG}"
while pgrep -u "$(id -u)" -x xfwm4 >/dev/null 2>&1 || \
      pgrep -u "$(id -u)" -x xfdesktop >/dev/null 2>&1 || \
      pgrep -u "$(id -u)" -x xfce4-panel >/dev/null 2>&1; do
    sleep 5
done
FS25_START-DESKTOP_SH
cat > /mnt/server/.fs25-egg/start.sh <<'FS25_START_SH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

log() { printf '[FS25] %s\n' "$*"; }

export HOME=/home/container
export USER=container
export LOGNAME=container
export WINEPREFIX="${HOME}/.fs25server"
export WINEARCH=win64
export WINEDEBUG="${WINEDEBUG:--all}"
export DISPLAY=:0
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/tmp/xdg-runtime-fs25

STATE_DIR="${HOME}/.fs25-egg"
GAME_ROOT="${HOME}/game"
GAME_DIR="${GAME_ROOT}/Farming Simulator 2025"
CONFIG_ROOT="${HOME}/config"
CONFIG_DIR="${CONFIG_ROOT}/FarmingSimulator2025"
INSTALLER_DIR="${HOME}/installer"
DLC_DIR="${HOME}/dlc"
LOG_DIR="${HOME}/logs"
DESKTOP_DIR="${HOME}/Desktop"

mkdir -p "${STATE_DIR}" "${GAME_DIR}" "${CONFIG_DIR}" "${INSTALLER_DIR}" \
    "${DLC_DIR}" "${LOG_DIR}" "${DESKTOP_DIR}" "${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR}" "${HOME}/.vnc"
chmod 700 "${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR}" "${HOME}/.vnc"

source "${STATE_DIR}/wine-runtime.sh"

children=()
cleanup() {
    local pid
    for pid in "${children[@]:-}"; do
        kill "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
    done
    wait 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM

rm -f /tmp/.X0-lock /tmp/.X11-unix/X0
vnc_command=(Xvnc :0 -depth 24 -geometry "${VNC_GEOMETRY:-1280x720}")
if [[ -n "${VNC_PASSWORD:-}" && "${#VNC_PASSWORD}" -ge 6 ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' "${VNC_PASSWORD}" | vncpasswd -f >"${HOME}/.vnc/passwd"
    chmod 600 "${HOME}/.vnc/passwd"
    vnc_command+=( -PasswordFile="${HOME}/.vnc/passwd" )
else
    vnc_command+=( -SecurityTypes=None )
fi
"${vnc_command[@]}" >"${LOG_DIR}/xvnc.log" 2>&1 &
XVNC_PID=$!
children+=("${XVNC_PID}")

for _ in {1..30}; do
    if DISPLAY=:0 xdpyinfo >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
    if ! kill -0 "${XVNC_PID}" 2>/dev/null; then
        log "Xvnc wurde beendet; siehe ${LOG_DIR}/xvnc.log"
        exit 1
    fi
    sleep 1
done

/usr/sbin/websockify --web /usr/share/webapps/novnc/ 6080 localhost:5900 \
    >"${LOG_DIR}/novnc.log" 2>&1 &
children+=("$!")

bash "${STATE_DIR}/start-desktop.sh" &
children+=("$!")

bash "${STATE_DIR}/ensure-wine-prefix.sh"
source "${STATE_DIR}/configure-headless-wine.sh"

link_persistent_directory() {
    local source="$1" target="$2"
    mkdir -p "${source}" "$(dirname "${target}")"
    if [[ -L "${target}" && "$(readlink "${target}")" == "${source}" ]]; then
        return
    fi
    if [[ -d "${target}" && ! -L "${target}" ]]; then
        cp -a "${target}/." "${source}/" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
    rm -rf "${target}"
    ln -s "${source}" "${target}"
}

link_persistent_directory "${GAME_DIR}" \
    "${WINEPREFIX}/drive_c/Program Files (x86)/Farming Simulator 2025"
link_persistent_directory "${CONFIG_DIR}" \
    "${WINEPREFIX}/drive_c/users/${USER}/Documents/My Games/FarmingSimulator2025"

cat >"${DESKTOP_DIR}/FS25 installieren.desktop" <<'DESKTOP'
[Desktop Entry]
Type=Application
Name=FS25 installieren / aktivieren
Exec=xfce4-terminal --hold --command="bash /home/container/.fs25-egg/setup.sh"
Terminal=false
Icon=system-software-install
DESKTOP

cat >"${DESKTOP_DIR}/FS25 Webserver starten.desktop" <<'DESKTOP'
[Desktop Entry]
Type=Application
Name=FS25 Webserver starten
Exec=xfce4-terminal --hold --command="bash /home/container/.fs25-egg/start-server.sh"
Terminal=false
Icon=applications-games
DESKTOP

cat >"${DESKTOP_DIR}/FS25 DLCs installieren.desktop" <<'DESKTOP'
[Desktop Entry]
Type=Application
Name=FS25 DLCs installieren
Exec=xfce4-terminal --hold --command="bash /home/container/.fs25-egg/install-dlcs.sh"
Terminal=false
Icon=system-software-install
DESKTOP
chmod +x "${DESKTOP_DIR}"/*.desktop

python3 "${STATE_DIR}/configure.py"

public_host="${PUBLIC_IP:-${SERVER_IP:-127.0.0.1}}"
log "Upstream-Image: toetje585/arch-fs25server:latest"
log "noVNC: http://${public_host}:6080/vnc.html?resize=remote&autoconnect=1"
log "GIANTS-Webinterface: http://${public_host}:${WEB_PORT:-7999}"
log "Spielport: ${SERVER_PORT:-10823}/tcp+udp"

if [[ -x "${GAME_DIR}/dedicatedServer.exe" ]]; then
    if [[ "${AUTO_INSTALL_DLC:-false}" == "true" || -f "${STATE_DIR}/dlc-autoinstall.enabled" ]]; then
        log "DLC-Automatik ist aktiviert. Fehlende Pakete werden vor dem Serverstart verarbeitet."
        bash "${STATE_DIR}/install-dlcs.sh"
    fi
    if [[ "${AUTOSTART_SERVER:-web_only}" == "true" || "${AUTOSTART_SERVER:-web_only}" == "web_only" ]]; then
        bash "${STATE_DIR}/start-server.sh" &
        children+=("$!")
    else
        log "Installation erkannt. Starte den Webserver über die Desktop-Verknüpfung."
    fi
else
    log "Noch keine Installation erkannt. Installer nach ${INSTALLER_DIR} hochladen."
    if [[ "${AUTO_INSTALL:-false}" == "true" ]] && find "${INSTALLER_DIR}" -maxdepth 1 -type f | grep -Eiq '\.(exe|img|iso|zip)$'; then
        bash "${STATE_DIR}/setup.sh" &
        children+=("$!")
    fi
fi

log "FS25 upstream compatibility layer ready."
wait "${XVNC_PID}"
FS25_START_SH
cat > /mnt/server/.fs25-egg/setup.sh <<'FS25_SETUP_SH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

export HOME="${FS25_HOME:-/home/container}"
export USER=container
export LOGNAME=container
export WINEPREFIX="${HOME}/.fs25server"
export WINEARCH=win64
export WINEDEBUG="${WINEDEBUG:--all}"
export DISPLAY=:0

INSTALLER_DIR="${HOME}/installer"
EXTRACTED_DIR="${INSTALLER_DIR}/extracted"
GAME_DIR="${HOME}/game/Farming Simulator 2025"
LOG_DIR="${HOME}/logs"
STATE_DIR="${FS25_EGG_DIR:-${HOME}/.fs25-egg}"
INSTALL_MODE="${INSTALL_MODE:-silent}"
INSTALL_TIMEOUT="${INSTALL_TIMEOUT:-7200}"
INSTALL_PROGRESS_INTERVAL="${INSTALL_PROGRESS_INTERVAL:-30}"
ACTIVATION_TIMEOUT="${ACTIVATION_TIMEOUT:-7200}"

mkdir -p "${INSTALLER_DIR}" "${EXTRACTED_DIR}" "${GAME_DIR}" "${LOG_DIR}"

source "${STATE_DIR}/wine-runtime.sh"
bash "${STATE_DIR}/ensure-wine-prefix.sh"
source "${STATE_DIR}/configure-headless-wine.sh"

if [[ ! -f "${GAME_DIR}/FarmingSimulator2025.exe" || ! -f "${GAME_DIR}/dedicatedServer.exe" ]]; then
installer=""
while IFS= read -r candidate; do
    installer="${candidate}"
    break
done < <(find "${INSTALLER_DIR}" -maxdepth 2 -type f \
    \( -iname 'Setup.exe' -o -iname 'FarmingSimulator2025.exe' \) | sort)

if [[ -z "${installer}" ]]; then
    archive=""
    while IFS= read -r candidate; do archive="${candidate}"; break; done \
        < <(find "${INSTALLER_DIR}" -maxdepth 1 -type f \
        \( -iname '*.img' -o -iname '*.iso' -o -iname '*.zip' \) | sort)
    if [[ -n "${archive}" ]]; then
        echo "[FS25] Entpacke $(basename "${archive}") ..."
        if command -v 7z >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            7z x -y -o"${EXTRACTED_DIR}" -- "${archive}"
        elif command -v 7zz >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            7zz x -y -o"${EXTRACTED_DIR}" -- "${archive}"
        elif command -v 7za >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            7za x -y -o"${EXTRACTED_DIR}" -- "${archive}"
        elif command -v bsdtar >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            bsdtar -xf "${archive}" -C "${EXTRACTED_DIR}"
        else
            echo "[FS25] Kein Archivprogramm vorhanden (7z/7zz/7za/bsdtar)."
            echo "[FS25] Setup.exe alternativ außerhalb des Containers entpacken und nach ${INSTALLER_DIR} hochladen."
            exit 1
        fi
        while IFS= read -r candidate; do installer="${candidate}"; break; done \
            < <(find "${EXTRACTED_DIR}" -type f \
            \( -iname 'Setup.exe' -o -iname 'FarmingSimulator2025.exe' \) | sort)
    fi
fi

if [[ -z "${installer}" ]]; then
    echo "[FS25] Kein Setup gefunden. IMG/ISO/ZIP oder Setup.exe nach ${INSTALLER_DIR} hochladen."
    exit 1
fi

# Some IMG extractors expose the ISO 9660 short names (SETUP_1A.BIN), while
# the Windows installer asks for the Joliet-style name (Setup-1a.bin). Keep the
# extracted files untouched and create hard-link aliases beside Setup.exe.
installer_dir="$(dirname "${installer}")"
installer_stem="$(basename "${installer}")"
installer_stem="${installer_stem%.*}"
case "${installer_stem,,}" in
    setup) installer_stem="Setup" ;;
    farmingsimulator2025) installer_stem="FarmingSimulator2025" ;;
esac

slice_aliases=0
while IFS= read -r -d '' slice; do
    slice_name="$(basename "${slice}")"
    if [[ "${slice_name}" =~ ^[^_]+_([0-9]+[A-Za-z])\.[Bb][Ii][Nn]$ ]]; then
        slice_suffix="${BASH_REMATCH[1],,}"
        slice_alias="${installer_dir}/${installer_stem}-${slice_suffix}.bin"
        if [[ ! -e "${slice_alias}" ]]; then
            if ln "${slice}" "${slice_alias}" 2>/dev/null; then
                link_kind="Hardlink"
            else
                ln -s "${slice_name}" "${slice_alias}"
                link_kind="Symlink"
            fi
            echo "[FS25] Datenträger-Dateiname korrigiert: ${slice_name} -> $(basename "${slice_alias}") (${link_kind})."
        fi
        slice_aliases=$((slice_aliases + 1))
    fi
done < <(find "${installer_dir}" -maxdepth 1 -type f -iname '*.bin' -print0)

if (( slice_aliases > 0 )); then
    echo "[FS25] ${slice_aliases} Installer-Slices sind unter den erwarteten Bindestrich-Namen verfügbar."
fi

installer_args=()
if [[ "${INSTALL_MODE}" == "silent" ]]; then
    # These are the same unattended flags used by the upstream image's setup_fs25.sh.
    installer_args=("/SILENT" "/NOCANCEL" "/NOICONS")
    echo "[FS25] Starte $(basename "${installer}") im Silent-Modus nach Upstream-Vorgabe."
else
    echo "[FS25] Starte $(basename "${installer}") interaktiv im noVNC-Desktop."
fi

install_log="${LOG_DIR}/fs25-installer.log"
: >"${install_log}"
cd "${installer_dir}"

echo "[FS25] Installations-Timeout: ${INSTALL_TIMEOUT}s; Fortschritt alle ${INSTALL_PROGRESS_INTERVAL}s."
(
    set -o pipefail
    timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=30s "${INSTALL_TIMEOUT}s" \
        wine "${installer}" "${installer_args[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "${install_log}"
) &
installer_pid=$!

elapsed=0
while kill -0 "${installer_pid}" 2>/dev/null; do
    sleep "${INSTALL_PROGRESS_INTERVAL}"
    elapsed=$((elapsed + INSTALL_PROGRESS_INTERVAL))
    installed_mib="$(du -sm "${GAME_DIR}" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')"
    installed_mib="${installed_mib:-0}"
    echo "[FS25] Installation läuft: ${elapsed}s, Spielverzeichnis: ${installed_mib} MiB, Log: ${install_log}"
done

if wait "${installer_pid}"; then
    installer_status=0
else
    installer_status=$?
fi

if [[ "${installer_status}" -ne 0 ]]; then
    echo "[FS25] Installer endete mit Status ${installer_status}. Letzte Logzeilen:"
    tail -n 60 "${install_log}" 2>/dev/null || true
    exit "${installer_status}"
fi

missing=()
for required in "${GAME_DIR}/FarmingSimulator2025.exe" "${GAME_DIR}/dedicatedServer.exe"; do
    [[ -f "${required}" ]] || missing+=("${required}")
done
if (( ${#missing[@]} > 0 )); then
    echo "[FS25] Installer meldete Erfolg, aber die Installation ist unvollständig. Fehlend:"
    printf '[FS25] - %s\n' "${missing[@]}"
    tail -n 60 "${install_log}" 2>/dev/null || true
    exit 1
fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

export HOME="${FS25_HOME:-/home/container}"
export USER=container
export LOGNAME=container
export WINEPREFIX="${HOME}/.fs25server"
export WINEARCH=win64
export WINEDEBUG="${WINEDEBUG:--all}"
export DISPLAY="${DISPLAY:-:0}"

STATE_DIR="${HOME}/.fs25-egg"
DLC_DIR="${HOME}/dlc"
PDLC_DIR="${HOME}/config/FarmingSimulator2025/pdlc"
LOG_DIR="${HOME}/logs"
DLC_PREFIX="FarmingSimulator25_"
DLC_INSTALL_TIMEOUT="${DLC_INSTALL_TIMEOUT:-7200}"

mkdir -p "${DLC_DIR}" "${PDLC_DIR}" "${LOG_DIR}"
source "${STATE_DIR}/wine-runtime.sh"
source "${STATE_DIR}/configure-headless-wine.sh"

extract_archive() {
    local archive="$1" temp_dir target file
    temp_dir="$(mktemp -d "${DLC_DIR}/.extract-XXXXXX")"
    echo "[FS25] Entpacke DLC-Archiv $(basename "${archive}") ..."
    if command -v 7z >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        7z x -y -o"${temp_dir}" -- "${archive}" >/dev/null
    elif command -v 7zz >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        7zz x -y -o"${temp_dir}" -- "${archive}" >/dev/null
    elif command -v 7za >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        7za x -y -o"${temp_dir}" -- "${archive}" >/dev/null
    elif command -v bsdtar >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        bsdtar -xf "${archive}" -C "${temp_dir}"
    else
        echo "[FS25] Kein Entpacker für $(basename "${archive}") vorhanden."
        rm -rf "${temp_dir}"
        return 1
    fi
    while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
        target="${DLC_DIR}/$(basename "${file}")"
        [[ -e "${target}" ]] || mv "${file}" "${target}"
    done < <(find "${temp_dir}" -type f -print0)
    rm -rf "${temp_dir}"
}

shopt -s nullglob nocasematch
for archive in "${DLC_DIR}"/${DLC_PREFIX}*.img \
               "${DLC_DIR}"/${DLC_PREFIX}*.iso \
               "${DLC_DIR}"/${DLC_PREFIX}*.zip; do
    [[ -e "${archive}" ]] || continue
    archive_base="$(basename "${archive}")"
    archive_name="${archive_base#${DLC_PREFIX}}"
    archive_name="${archive_name%%_*}"
    if compgen -G "${DLC_DIR}/${DLC_PREFIX}${archive_name}_*.exe" >/dev/null; then
        continue
    fi
    extract_archive "${archive}"
done

installers=("${DLC_DIR}"/${DLC_PREFIX}*.exe)
if (( ${#installers[@]} == 0 )); then
    echo "[FS25] Keine DLC-Installer in ${DLC_DIR} gefunden."
    exit 0
fi

echo "[FS25] Automatische DLC-Reihenfolge aktiv: ${#installers[@]} Paket(e)."
echo "[FS25] noVNC geöffnet lassen; Produktschlüssel werden weiterhin manuell eingegeben."

failures=0
for installer in "${installers[@]}"; do
    base="$(basename "${installer}")"
    raw="${base#${DLC_PREFIX}}"
    dlc_name="${raw%%_*}"
    expected="${PDLC_DIR}/${dlc_name}.dlc"

    if [[ -f "${expected}" ]]; then
        echo "[FS25] DLC ${dlc_name} ist bereits installiert; überspringe ${base}."
        continue
    fi

    before="$(find "${PDLC_DIR}" -maxdepth 1 -type f -iname '*.dlc' -printf '%f\n' | sort)"
    safe_name="${base//[^A-Za-z0-9._-]/_}"
    install_log="${LOG_DIR}/dlc-${safe_name}.log"
    echo "[FS25] Starte DLC ${dlc_name}: ${base}"
    echo "[FS25] Bitte den Produktschlüssel im noVNC-Fenster eingeben. Timeout: ${DLC_INSTALL_TIMEOUT}s."

    set +e
    timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=30s "${DLC_INSTALL_TIMEOUT}s" \
        wine "${installer}" 2>&1 | tee "${install_log}"
    status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
    set -e

    after="$(find "${PDLC_DIR}" -maxdepth 1 -type f -iname '*.dlc' -printf '%f\n' | sort)"
    if [[ "${status}" -eq 0 && ( -f "${expected}" || "${after}" != "${before}" ) ]]; then
        echo "[FS25] DLC ${dlc_name} wurde installiert."
    else
        echo "[FS25] DLC ${dlc_name} ist nicht vollständig installiert (Status ${status}); Log: ${install_log}"
        failures=$((failures + 1))
    fi
done

if (( failures > 0 )); then
    echo "[FS25] ${failures} DLC-Installation(en) müssen beim nächsten Start erneut bestätigt werden."
    exit 1
fi

echo "[FS25] Alle gefundenen DLC-Installer wurden verarbeitet."
FS25_INSTALL-DLCS_SH

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os
import pathlib
import tempfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

HOME = pathlib.Path(os.environ.get("FS25_HOME", "/home/container"))
GAME = HOME / "game" / "Farming Simulator 2025"
CONFIG = HOME / "config" / "FarmingSimulator2025" / "dedicated_server"


def env(name: str, default: str = "") -> str:
    return os.environ.get(name, default)


def port(name: str, default: str) -> str:
    value = env(name, default)
    try:
        number = int(value)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise SystemExit(f"[FS25] {name} muss eine Zahl sein: {value}") from exc
    if not 1024 <= number <= 65535:
        raise SystemExit(f"[FS25] {name} muss zwischen 1024 und 65535 liegen: {number}")
    return str(number)


def atomic_xml(path: pathlib.Path, root: ET.Element) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    ET.indent(root, space="    ")
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile("wb", dir=path.parent, delete=False) as handle:
        tmp = pathlib.Path(handle.name)
        ET.ElementTree(root).write(handle, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=True)
    ET.parse(tmp)
    os.replace(tmp, path)


web_port = port("WEB_PORT", "7999")
game_port = port("SERVER_PORT", "10823")
if web_port == game_port:
    raise SystemExit("[FS25] WEB_PORT und der primaere SERVER_PORT muessen verschieden sein")

config_path = CONFIG / "dedicatedServerConfig.xml"
requested_map = env("SERVER_MAP", "").strip()
saved_map_id = ""
saved_map_filename = ""
if config_path.is_file():
    try:
        previous = ET.parse(config_path).getroot()
        saved_map_id = (previous.findtext("./settings/mapID") or "").strip()
        saved_map_filename = (previous.findtext("./settings/mapFilename") or "").strip()
    except (ET.ParseError, OSError):
        pass

if requested_map:
    map_id = requested_map
    map_filename = "default"
    map_source = "Panelvariable"
elif saved_map_id:
    map_id = saved_map_id
    map_filename = saved_map_filename or "default"
    map_source = "GIANTS-Webinterface"
else:
    map_id = "MapUS"
    map_filename = "default"
    map_source = "Erststart-Standard"

server = ET.Element("server")
web = ET.SubElement(server, "webserver", {"port": web_port})
admin = ET.SubElement(web, "initial_admin")
ET.SubElement(admin, "username").text = env("WEB_USERNAME", "admin")
ET.SubElement(admin, "passphrase").text = env("WEB_PASSWORD", "webpassword")
ET.SubElement(
    server,
    "game",
    {
        "description": "Farming Simulator 25",
        "name": "FarmingSimulator2025",
        "exe": "FarmingSimulator2025Game.exe",
    },
)
atomic_xml(GAME / "dedicatedServer.xml", server)

gameserver = ET.Element("gameserver")
settings = ET.SubElement(gameserver, "settings")
values = {
    "game_name": env("SERVER_NAME", "FS25 Server"),
    "admin_password": env("SERVER_ADMIN", "adminpassword"),
    "game_password": env("SERVER_PASSWORD", ""),
    "savegame_index": env("SAVEGAME_INDEX", "1"),
    "max_player": env("SERVER_PLAYERS", "16"),
    "port": game_port,
    "language": env("SERVER_REGION", "de"),
    "auto_save_interval": env("SERVER_SAVE_INTERVAL", "180.000000"),
    "stats_interval": env("SERVER_STATS_INTERVAL", "31536000"),
    "crossplay_allowed": env("SERVER_CROSSPLAY", "true"),
    "pause_game_if_empty": env("SERVER_PAUSE", "2"),
    "mapID": map_id,
    "mapFilename": map_filename,
}
for key, value in values.items():
    ET.SubElement(settings, key).text = value
atomic_xml(config_path, gameserver)

print(
    "[FS25] Konfiguration geschrieben: "
    f"web={web_port} game={game_port} map={map_id} ({map_source})"
)
FS25_CONFIGURE_PY
